Subject: Ridgeway north depot downtime and ROI

Hi Carla,

Thanks for the long session today. Hearing that cutting downtime at the north depot is the priority helped me focus on what matters most for you.

Since your CFO needs to sign off before Tuesday's budget meeting, I'll get the one-page ROI summary to you in time. To make the numbers accurate, I need your north depot's current downtime, like hours lost per month or how many trucks are out of service at once.

Could you send those by [day/time]? That gives me enough time to get the summary to you before Tuesday.

Thanks,
[Your name]

Before you send:
- Add your name and the day/time you want the downtime numbers by.
- I picked the next step (sending north depot downtime figures) because the notes don't include one. Change it if you agreed on something else.
- I haven't written the ROI summary, since the notes have no figures. Make sure it's ready before Tuesday.
